L.method: Independent VTK actual same-hand terminal thumb/index triangle-surface intersections
L.limits: Actual terminal body surfaces, not helper bone-tip anchors. A contact curve/overlap requires closeup review; not a claim about every finger/whole-hand collision.
L.distance_method: Actual terminal vertex samples to opposite actual terminal triangles, both directions; upper bound on exact minimum surface distance, not helper point.
